classification.difficultyReason: Finds hours needed at a different penalty rate to earn the same pay.

content.prompt: Luke’s normal rate of pay is \$15 per hour. Last week he was paid for 12 hours, at time-and-a-half. How many hours would Luke need to work this week, at double time, to earn the same amount?

answer.worked: $$\begin{aligned}\text{Last week's pay} &= 15\times12\times1.5\\\text{Last week's pay} &= \$270\\\text{Double-time hourly rate} &= 15\times2 = \$30/\text{h}\\\text{Hours needed} &= 270\div30 = 9\text{ hours}\end{aligned}$$
